source_name: Народна банка на РСМ — Македонски интербанкарски платен систем (МИПС)
why_relevant: Public-institution operator of the RTGS system; MIPS modernisation (ISO 20022, EU-funded) and the instant-payments/TIPS-clone programme are the single largest state-adjacent payments infrastructure projects, with vendor and bank participation.

source_name: Влада на РСМ (Government of North Macedonia) — sessions, decisions, open government
why_relevant: Adopts strategies, decrees and implementation programmes; session conclusions are often the first public record that a fiscalisation/e-invoicing/instant-payments decision has been taken and funded.

source_name: Службен весник на РСМ (Official Gazette)
why_relevant: Authoritative publication of every law and bylaw, including the Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи (Сл. весник 90/2022), fiscalisation rulebooks and NBRM decisions. The legally binding text behind every programme in this cell.

source_name: Стопанска комора на Северна Македонија — прописи/legislation tracker
why_relevant: Business chamber that mirrors Official Gazette texts and draft laws (including payment/banking amendments and e-invoicing rules) with commentary and member consultations — an accessible proxy for gazette content and an early read on industry pushback.

source_name: Огледало на Владата (Government Mirror) — ENER monitoring reports
why_relevant: Civil-society watchdog producing monthly/quarterly reports on ENER compliance and a curated directory of state institutions and portals — an efficient snowball map of government sources and a check on what government failed to publish.

source_name: Фонд за здравствено осигурување (ФЗО) and similar state funds — procurement document stores
why_relevant: Public-adjacent institutions that mirror Public Procurement Bureau documents and run their own payment-related IT procurement; useful as secondary copies of MoF/BJN documents and as additional buyer signals.

source_name: e-Faktura vendor/advisory explainer sites (earhiva.mk, facturino.mk, racin.mk)
why_relevant: Commercial e-invoicing providers and accounting portals that document the UJP e-Faktura rollout timeline (pilot from January, mandatory October 2026), technical requirements (XML, KIBS signature, EUID) and phased scope — they surface implementation detail faster than official pages and reveal who is positioning as a vendor.

source_name: МИА / Makfax / MKD.mk — state and mainstream news agencies (fiscal & payments beat)
why_relevant: MIA is the state news agency; together with Makfax and MKD.mk it carries verbatim MoF, UJP and NBRM statements (e.g. Fiscal Strategy 2027-2031, MIPS modernisation milestones) often before the institutions' own sites are updated.

source_name: UNDP North Macedonia — digital readiness / digital public infrastructure reporting
why_relevant: Donor/implementing partner for government digitalisation; its blogs and project pages assess digital public infrastructure and digital payments and name government counterparts and programmes — a credible external audit layer on state claims.

source_name: National Digital ID programme coverage (Mastercard newsroom, Evrotrust, Biometric Update)
why_relevant: Documents the state's digital identity partnership (national digital ID with Mastercard, operated by Evrotrust) and the digital ID wallet / mDL connected to the government services portal — a concrete case of a state mandate forcing a vendor selection in the identity-and-payments stack.

source_name: Државен завод за ревизија (ДЗР) — Ревизорски извештаи
why_relevant: Central repository of State Audit Office final audit reports (PDF). Regularity/performance audits routinely name IT and payment-system procurements, suppliers, contract values in denars and irregularities at public entities, state-owned banks/funds and the central bank — a hard, adversarial evidence source for vendor and pricing intelligence.

source_name: ДЗР — Ревизорски извештаи за област НБРМ (central-bank audit area)
why_relevant: Sub-section isolating State Audit Office audits of the National Bank itself — the single most on-point place for findings about central-bank IT/payment-infrastructure spending, contracts and suppliers.

source_name: ДЗР — Планирани ревизии (planned audits register)
why_relevant: Early-warning list of which entities and which audit types are scheduled. Lets you anticipate, months ahead, which bank/state-entity procurement files will become public and prioritise monitoring.

source_name: ДЗР — Годишни извештаи на Државниот завод за ревизија
why_relevant: Annual synthesis of audit findings; useful for spotting systemic procurement/IT-contracting themes across the public and financial sector, and for identifying recurring named entities worth deep-diving.

source_name: Комисија за заштита на конкуренцијата (КЗК) — Одлуки во управна постапка
why_relevant: Competition authority administrative decisions — the place where card-scheme fees, interchange, exclusive acquiring/processing arrangements and abuse-of-dominance cases involving banks and PSPs would be adjudicated and reasoned in public text naming the parties.

source_name: КЗК — Одлуки во прекршочна постапка (infringement/fine decisions)
why_relevant: Fine/misdemeanour decisions naming firms sanctioned for cartel conduct or for supplying false/incomplete data — adversarial disclosure of market-structure disputes. Precedent exists (e.g. КЗК sanctions reported against a chamber of commerce and retail chains).

source_name: КЗК — Известувања за концентрации (merger notifications)
why_relevant: Merger/acquisition notifications disclose ownership changes in banks and payment firms before they are announced commercially — e.g. a 2026 notification of AIK Grup (CY) acquiring control over Podravska Banka. Directly feeds competitor and partnership mapping.

source_name: КЗК — Одлуки во судовите (court review of competition decisions)
why_relevant: Administrative-court outcomes on appealed competition decisions; reveals which sanctioned market players fought back and the factual record argued in court.

source_name: КЗК — Годишни извештаи
why_relevant: Annual report aggregates case counts by sector, including financial services; a fast way to detect whether banking/cards were an enforcement focus in a given year and to recover case references.

source_name: НБРСМ — Супервизија (supervision hub)
why_relevant: Central bank's supervision landing page for banks, savings houses, exchange offices and payment service providers — entry point to supervisory measures, licence decisions and supervision reports that reveal which PSPs are licensed, sanctioned or wound down.

source_name: НБРСМ — Одлуки од областа на супервизијата
why_relevant: The supervisory-decision register: rules on how supervision and on-site inspection is conducted, on issuing licences (дозволи) and consents (согласности). Licence/consent decisions expose ownership changes, new payment institutions and e-money issuers entering the market.

source_name: Државна комисија за спречување на корупцијата (ДКСК)
why_relevant: Anti-corruption commission opens cases on audit findings (it has done so directly off State Audit Office reports) and publishes procurement-risk analyses; it signed a cooperation memorandum with the National Bank (14 July 2022). Cases name entities, contracts and officials.

source_name: Агенција за заштита на личните податоци (АЗЛП)
why_relevant: Data-protection supervisor with inspection and misdemeanour powers over banks and payment processors. Inspection findings and sanctions expose which systems, processors and outsourced vendors handle customer data at named institutions.

source_name: Организација на потрошувачите на Македонија (ОПМ) — Даватели на финансиски услуги
why_relevant: The main consumer organisation's financial-services desk: complaint handling against banks and payment service providers, plus a published handbook on protecting users of financial services. Surfaces recurring grievance patterns (fees, cards, e-payments) and names institutions.

source_name: NBRNM — Register of electronic money institutions (Регистар на институции за електронски пари)
why_relevant: Authoritative list of licensed e-money institutions in MK — the definitive roster of non-bank wallet/e-money challengers (e.g. Iute Pay) and the entry point for tracking new entrants.

source_name: NBRNM — Payment institutions, e-money institutions and payment system operators (hub page)
why_relevant: Hub linking all non-bank PSP registers and the licensing regime; snowballs into individual registers, sub-laws and operator lists.

source_name: NBRNM — Providers of fast money transfer services (Даватели на услуги БТП)
why_relevant: Identifies licensed remittance / fast money transfer providers and their bank partners — core to mapping the MK remittance channel and who acquires/settles for whom.
